nary_nodes.label: Real Madrid sign Yan Diomande from RB Leipzig
evidence: Real Madrid have announced the signing of 19-year-old Ivory Coast winger Yan Diomande from RB Leipzig for what Spanish media reported was a club-record fee of 140 million euros ($161m) including bonuses.
Los Blancos said in a statement on Thursday that a deal had been reached with the Bundesliga side for Diomande, “who is tied to our club for the next seven seasons, until June 30, 2033”.

nary_nodes.label: Real Madrid beat PSG and Liverpool to Diomande
evidence: Madrid, who did not disclose the transfer fee, beat Paris Saint-Germain and Liverpool to the signing of Diomande
PSG pulled out of the running because of concerns over the size of the transfer fee, while Liverpool reportedly had a bid rejected in June.

nary_nodes.label: Diomande transfers to RB Leipzig from Leganes
evidence: Diomande spent one season in the German top flight with Leipzig following a switch from Spanish side Leganes in 2025.

nary_nodes.label: Real Madrid hire Jose Mourinho as coach
evidence: Madrid, who hired Portuguese veteran Jose Mourinho as coach for a second spell to replace Alvaro Arbeloa

nary_nodes.label: Real Madrid overhaul squad after trophy drought
evidence: Madrid, who hired Portuguese veteran Jose Mourinho as coach for a second spell to replace Alvaro Arbeloa, are overhauling their squad after going two consecutive seasons without a major trophy.

nary_nodes.label: Diomande participates in World Cup with Ivory Coast
evidence: Diomande, who played at the World Cup with his country.

nary_nodes.label: Diomande wins Bundesliga Young Player of the Season
evidence: He was the Bundesliga young player of the season, netting 12 goals and laying on eight assists.

nary_nodes.label: Real Madrid linked with Rodri transfer
evidence: Madrid have also been linked with a move for Manchester City and Spain midfielder Rodri.
